_note: Batch 2 (post round-3 review, FINAL/shippable). 4 sci-fi theme tag sets completing the sample set of 10 (#0 original + 5 batch1 + 4 here). SEEDS for the world-gen pipeline (storybrain/generator). Requirements: sci-fi, artifacts, alien civilizations (need NOT be fallen). Resource tie-ins welcome but not mandatory. Psychic OPTIONAL (per Sam) — kept light (3 none / 1 subtle), NOT piled on. Breadth is the goal: each must produce worlds distinct from the others, from batch1, and from theme #0 (the marrow/Velt/Choir world in generator/world-scifi.json: fallen-civ + resource-exploitation-of-a-living-organism-gone-terribly-wrong + overt psychic cascade + reconstruct-the-linear-fall). The decisive test per batch1's reviews is the MYSTERY SPINE: each seed must imply a structurally different story shape than #0's linear cause->escalation->collapse autopsy. Spines here: AWE/where-did-they-go/what-was-it-FOR (megastructure), OUTBREAK/containment-race/assemble-the-recipe-before-it-arrives (plague), MERCANTILE/whose-history-is-real/trace-the-true-provenance (trade), STEWARDSHIP/are-we-the-experiment/what-are-we-being-grown-INTO (uplift). ORDER-AXIS CAVEAT (round-2, sharpened round-3): the pipeline's mystery primitive is mystery={fragments[],order[]} and prompt-canon.md hard-codes 'order' as a caused_by death chain (cause->escalation->point-of-no-return->collapse); schema.ts comments it 'the why-it-fell chain' and reconstructFall() follows caused_by by name. These seeds deliberately use NON-death order relations: megastructure reconstructs a RETROSPECTIVE/OUTWARD purpose ('enables/reveals' — what the absent builders built it FOR and where they WENT), uplift reconstructs a PROSPECTIVE/INWARD purpose ('reveals-method' — what the hidden gardeners are growing US INTO), plague reconstructs a FORWARD CONTAINMENT RECIPE ('prerequisite/enables' — identify->trigger->keystone->seal), trade reconstructs a relic's TRUE PROVENANCE ('precedes' — oldest link to newest, lies stripped). Generalizing the order RELATION (not just the status enum + mystery prose) is the DEEPEST pipeline-generalization these seeds spec; see round-3 review R3-D. ALIEN_STATUS CONTROLLED VOCABULARY (use exactly these): living (present, conscious, agency now) | active (present, operating, non-communicative/indifferent) | ambiguous (alive-or-dead genuinely undecided) | absent (makers gone — left or vanished, NOT a witnessed fall) | hidden (present and acting but never seen) | dormant (sleeping/sealed, wakeable — and waking is the threat) | extinct (gone, only a corpse-civ remains) | ancestral (the makers are our forebears) | fallen (witnessed collapse — reserved for #0-style autopsies, avoided here). Batch2 status spread (round-3 final): absent / dormant / living / hidden — four DISTINCT statuses, none doubled within batch2, and NONE duplicating a batch1 status used the same way (batch1: living x2, active, ambiguous, absent; plague was flipped extinct->ambiguous in round-2 then ambiguous->DORMANT in round-3 to (a) kill the corpse-autopsy posture even harder than ambiguous, (b) avoid doubling time-war's `ambiguous`, and (c) introduce a net-new status across the 10-set sample — `dormant` fits plague's true texture: sealed sleepers/carriers whose WAKING is the present-tense clock, with 'are any makers still alive in quarantine' surviving as flavor inside the dormant frame). RESOURCE_CENTRALITY: none | low | moderate | high | core. Batch2 resource spread: high / low / moderate / core. PIPELINE CAVEAT (carried from batch1 round-3, re-confirmed round-3 against source): generator/prompt-canon.md + schema.ts currently hard-code status:'fallen|extant', a MANDATORY civ-tied psychic power, and a mystery shaped as a caused_by fall-chain (validateWorld() requires order be a permutation of fragments and treats the chain as caused_by; check.ts exits nonzero on failure; reconstructFall() filters by caused_by-ordered reveals). These seeds DELIBERATELY use statuses (absent/dormant/living/hidden), non-fall mystery spines (awe/race/mercantile/stewardship), non-caused_by order relations, and mostly-none psychic that the current pipeline would reject or coerce back toward #0. Treat them as the SPEC for generalizing the enum + the mystery shape + the ORDER RELATION + making psychic genuinely optional, NOT as conforming to today's contract.

sets.title: The Inheritance
sets.hook: Humanity arrives INSIDE a working megastructure the size of a solar system — and its builders are simply GONE. No bodies, no war, no graves, no autopsy to perform: this is not a fall, and they were not us. The artifacts are control-keys that switch dormant pieces of the structure back on; each activation lights a new region and a new clue. The mystery is not how they died but where they WENT, and what this thing was built to DO — and whether finishing what they started is a gift or a trap.
sets.artifact_flavor: Control-keys and access-sigils that wake dormant megastructure systems. Power and matter ARE here in vast quantity, but exploiting them is instrumental, not the point: every key you find both lights up usable capacity AND drops a fragment of the builders' purpose — and risks waking a subsystem that was switched off for a reason. The hunt is light-the-machine-piece-by-piece, where each light is also a clue. The ordered chain reconstructs a finished, abandoned PURPOSE (what the structure was built to do and where the builders went) — a retrospective 'enables/reveals' sequence, NOT a death-cause chain.
sets.distinct_from_siblings: Scale and AWE, not bodies and not a fall. Aliens left no corpse to excavate (vs #0 and plague) and no live presence to negotiate with (vs trade) — only an inhabited machine and an unanswered 'why'. Distinct from gen-ship's `absent` too: those makers erased themselves and turn out to be us; these are genuinely OTHER, genuinely vanished, and the spine is what-was-it-for, not it-was-us. Distinct from uplift even though both are PURPOSE-reveals: megastructure's order is RETROSPECTIVE and OUTWARD — what the absent builders BUILT IT FOR and where they WENT, an answer that lives in the past; uplift's order is PROSPECTIVE and INWARD — what active gardeners are growing US INTO, an answer aimed at the player's future. Resource is high but serves the awe-mystery, never replaces it.

sets.title: The Quarantine Worlds
sets.hook: A self-replicating extinction-vector (gray-goo / memetic / biological) tore through an alien civilization — and the survivors are not dead, they are SEALED. The makers went into quarantine-sleep behind their own containment, dormant in sealed vaults alongside the dormant carriers of the thing that hunted them. Waking either is the threat. This is not a fall to reconstruct. The story is PRESENT TENSE: the vector still sleeps in sealed worlds and stirs in drifting carriers, and your colony is now inside its range. Hunting quarantined relics and the scattered pieces of a CONTAINMENT recipe is a RACE to assemble the seal before something wakes — and every relic you crack might be the next outbreak.
sets.artifact_flavor: Sealed quarantine-relics and containment-recipe fragments, each a LIVE hazard. Assembling the right set, IN ORDER, yields a working seal or vaccine; opening the wrong one reseeds the plague here, now — or wakes a dormant carrier (or a dormant sleeper) that does it for you. The hunt has a real downside the player can lose by — you can spread the very thing you sought. Crucially the ordered chain is FORWARD-FACING — a containment PROTOCOL you must reconstruct (identify the vector's nature -> find its dormancy trigger -> locate the keystone relic -> the assembly that seals it), a 'prerequisite/enables' chain, NOT a backward caused_by autopsy of how the aliens died. The aliens' death is at most ONE early fragment ('proof the vector is real and lethal'); the rest of the chain is what's STILL sealed out there and how to stop it from waking. The generative variable is the vector's NATURE per world (nanite swarm / mind-virus that spreads through the relics' lore / engineered pathogen) plus whether the sealed sleepers can be safely woken as allies or are themselves carriers, which changes what containment even means.
sets.distinct_from_siblings: Spine is OUTBREAK / containment-race, present tense — explicitly NOT #0's caused_by autopsy of how-they-fell. Status is `dormant` (the makers sealed themselves in quarantine-sleep alongside the dormant carriers; WAKING either is the threat) precisely to refuse the corpse-to-dissect posture — there is no corpse-civ to dissect, there are sleepers and a clock. The live question faces FORWARD: not 'how did they die' but 'what is still sealed and can we seal ourselves before it wakes.' The hunt is a clock with a fail-state (reseed the plague / wake a sleeper), unlike megastructure's awe-stroll or trade's deal-making. `dormant` is net-new across the 10-set sample (no batch1 or #0 set uses it) and avoids doubling time-war's `ambiguous`. Distinct from time-war regardless: time-war's uncertainty is a CAUSALITY paradox (the war is still resolving, meaning inverts under each find); plague has no uncertainty about its order at all — it is a known forward EPIDEMIOLOGY protocol you race to complete. Resource is low: the engine is containment, not extraction.

sets.title: The Long Bazaar
sets.hook: The galaxy is ALIVE and crowded — dozens of minor alien species trading, scheming, and feuding across a busy frontier. No grand empire, no tomb, no single mind: a marketplace. Artifacts are black-market curios whose power is inseparable from their PROVENANCE — and half the provenance is forged. The contested commodity everyone wants a cut of is not what the brokers say it is; tracing it to its real source is the deal nobody dares close. The story is whose history is even real, who you deal with, and who you cross to get it.
sets.artifact_flavor: Curios and relics moving on a black market, where an artifact's power depends on a (often forged) provenance chain. The HUNT is find-and-authenticate: track a rumored relic across living factions, then trace its TRUE chain of custody back through layered forgeries — and the ordered chain you reconstruct is the relic's real provenance, oldest link to newest, with each lie stripped revealing one true link AND a fragment of the contested commodity's actual origin (what it really is / who really made these relics everyone's been faking). The reconstruction ends in a deal, a heist, or a forgery, not a dig. The generative engine is the FACTION WEB + the specific contested commodity + its latent true-origin: worlds diverge on WHO is feuding over WHAT and what the WHAT secretly is, so no two read as the same bazaar.
sets.distinct_from_siblings: The only LIVED-IN, crowded, mercantile galaxy of many SHALLOW transactional factions — distinct from first-contact's single attentive alien gatekeeper (there the puzzle is YOUR worthiness; here it's the RELIC'S history). Tone is noir/political; the 'civilization' is a market, and the mystery is whose-provenance-is-real with a latent true-origin payoff, not why-anyone-fell. Distinct from time-war even though both reconstruct an order: trade's true provenance is a FIXED, SINGULAR past obscured by forgery — you remove lies to reach the one real sequence (authentication/detective); time-war has NO fixed order and each find INVERTS the meaning of the others (paradox). Distinct from #0 in every axis: living aliens, social spine, no collapse.

sets.title: The Gardeners' Patience
sets.hook: The world is being deliberately cultivated — life here is too convenient, too AIMED — by gardeners who are present and acting but never seen. The artifacts are their shaping-tools, seeded into the soil to steer evolution; the resource is the engineered biosphere itself. The mystery: WHAT are they cultivating us FOR? Is the colony a welcome guest, a pest to be culled, or the next thing being grown?
sets.artifact_flavor: Gardeners' shaping-tools — terraforming seeds, gene-looms, soil-shrines — that let you steer or exploit the living world while possibly tripping the gardeners' attention; each reveals a little of their METHOD and intent. The ordered chain is a PROSPECTIVE, INWARD purpose-reveal — what the gardeners are doing TO US right now and what we are being grown INTO — assembled forward toward a still-unfolding goal, not backward into anyone's death. The generative variable is the gardeners' INTENT per world (benevolent stewards / indifferent experimenters / breeders shaping us for a purpose / quarantiners testing whether we're safe to release), which changes whether using a tool is gratitude, theft, or playing into their plan.
sets.distinct_from_siblings: Aliens are HIDDEN and active (neither dead nor openly present — sensed, not seen), and the spine is stewardship-vs-exploitation with the player possibly BEING the experiment — a moral/ecological frame absent from the others. Distinct from megastructure even though both reveal a PURPOSE: uplift's order is PROSPECTIVE and INWARD (what active, watching gardeners are growing US into — the answer is in the player's future), where megastructure's is RETROSPECTIVE and OUTWARD (what the absent builders built the machine for and where they went — the answer is in the past). The subtle psychic register is its own flavor: sensing the world's 'aimed-ness' and the gardeners' watching attention (NOT time-war's precognition, NOT gen-ship's ancestral memory). Resource is core — the biosphere IS the prize — but the question is whether exploiting it is the smart move or the trap, the opposite of #0's exploit-and-perish certainty.
